subject: Control Systems
question: A unity-feedback system has the open-loop transfer function G(s) = 10 / (s(s + 2)). What is the steady-state error for a unit step input?
solution: G(s) has a single pole at the origin, so it is a type-1 system. The position error constant is Kp = lim(s->0) G(s) = infinity, and the steady-state error to a unit step is 1/(1 + Kp) = 0. A type-1 system tracks a step with zero error and a ramp with a finite error (here Kv = 5, so 0.2).
author: Rajon Das
